messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm 24-month commitment for the full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. You prioritise firm, long-term commitments, so we offer one: the full 23400 pcs per year over 24 months, or alternatively 36 months, with 42 days lead time. The attached term sheets set out both.

Our bottom-up estimate cost:340010 puts this seal at EUR 24.31 per unit at your plant. Our forecast fc:340010@2026-09 records a 10.1% volume increase, which gives you a growing, planned load. Your scorecard sc:70410@2026Q3 shows 79.5% on-time delivery, so a firm lead time matters to us.

As this exceeds a 2% change, could your pricing committee review it? What is your earliest confirmable lead time?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm 24-month commitment for the full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your volume forecast and can accommodate the 24-month commitment for 23400 units per year. Our pricing is based on actual production parameters rather than theoretical cost estimates, allowing us to offer a price of €31.70 per unit. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Part 340010 – firm 23400 pcs/year commitment, request for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for accepting the full 23400 pcs per year over 24 months. Your note of 27 March asked for a binding commitment of at least 12 months before confirming additional volume. We offer 24 months, or 36 months if that helps your capacity planning.

The attached term sheets show three packages. Two of them use a 42-day lead time, which matches your standard lead time. The third keeps your 56-day lead time at a lower price.

As the gap to your offer exceeds 2%, could your pricing committee review it at its next meeting? Could you also tell us the earliest lead time you can confirm for scheduled call-offs?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 340010 – firm 23400 pcs/year commitment, request for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our neues Angebot. Please decide, as this is our letztes Angebot. 

Pricing decisions are made by segment management; we do not conduct committee reviews. We offer a price of €31.60 per unit for the 24-month commitment at a volume of 23400 pcs per year with a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

Please note that our earliest confirmable lead time for scheduled call-offs without a price premium is 56 days, giving us a Lieferzeit of 56 days. This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Part 340010 – firm 23400 pcs/year commitment, request for pricing committee review
messages.body:

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
